subject: Exclusive Summer Sale - Limited Time Offer!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive summer sale with up to 50% off on selected items! Don't miss out on this limited time offer to upgrade your wardrobe with the latest summer fashion trends. Visit our store or shop online to browse through our collection and enjoy huge savings. Hurry, as stocks are limited! Thank you for shopping with us. Warm regards, The Fashion House Team
